notes.title: Witches of Ravenbrook Kickstarter Launched!
notes.content:
[p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/bottledstarlight/witches-of-ravenbrook"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/bottledstarlight/witches-of-ravenbrook[/url]

Our next major project, in partnership with InkyFluffDraws, is Witches of Ravenbrook! Don't worry, we're still working on RoP and our other projects, this is just the next big one.

If you like TF RPGs then you're going to like this one. Check out the KS and, if you like the look of it, consider backing it. Thanks![/p]

notes.title: Vote for us in the Steam Awards!
notes.content: Hey remember the game String Tyrant, the game whose page you found this on? Well now you can try to get us a Steam award. If you like the game, do it! If not, don't! It's wide open, you have a lot of options.

notes.title: String Tyrant 1 Year Anniversary Sale
notes.content: As of March 31st, String Tyrant will be 1 year old. So now it's on sale for 20% off for the month of March.

notes.title: Patch v.106
notes.content:
Version 1.06 is now live on Steam. Changelog:
*Fixed a map bug on the second floor
*Fixed an error with Eileen's dialogue.
*Fixed a bug where "Welcome to the Manor" was being awarded during the tutorial.
*Fixed keyboard settings not respecting non-English keyboard layouts in SDL.
*Added whitespace trimmer to text parser.
*Alt and Tab no longer count as keypresses so you can switch programs without advancing the text.
